_comment: Last upstream release the watcher has been told about — not a claim that xtctx has been tested against it. The nightly upstream-watch workflow compares npm against this file and opens an issue when a tracked tool publishes a new release: a free signal for when a format *could* have changed, without spending API credit invoking the tools. Bump these once the release has been looked at. What actually verifies a format is `npm run capture:formats`, which reads the transcript stores on the machine it runs on — so it only proves anything about the tool versions installed there, which are often older than these.

_untracked.cursor: not distributed on npm — format changes ship with the Cursor app
_untracked.copilot (VS Code): not on npm — ships inside the VS Code extension
_untracked.antigravity: not on npm — ships with the Antigravity app
